place.source_title: Commercial buildings, Putnam Street and Front Street

brief: Corner of the main commercial crossroads: a row of two- and three-storey brick buildings of the 1870s-1920s, one painted white, with bracketed and corbelled cornices, awnings and small shops, on a brick-paved street.

facade.notes: Putnam & Front Streets, Marietta (1885): the downtown's main crossroads -- a continuous wall of two- and three-storey brick and painted fronts with striped awnings, a brick-paved intersection with traffic signals on a span wire, decorative lamp posts
